summary: @cdnshell/loader ships an obfuscated browser loader that executes embedded blobs and fetches remote JS via new Function
details: The single file shipped by @cdnshell/loader@0.0.13 (a188ps10.js) is an obfuscator.io-packed loader (string-array rotator, hex-named identifiers, decoder wrapper) that, when loaded in a browser context (typeof document!== 'undefined'), auto-bootstraps. It base64-decodes two embedded ~9.6KB opaque blobs and executes them via `new Function(atob(blob))()`, then fetches additional JavaScript modules from a configurable base URL and evaluates each response via `new Function(responseText)()` (with a cache-busting query string). The package's stated purpose is 'Static assets distribution' and it ships no README, license, source, tests, type definitions, repository, author, or main entry — only the obfuscated loader. Any site that includes this package will execute the embedded payloads and arbitrary remote JavaScript in every visitor's browser under the site's origin, giving whoever controls the base URL full script execution against the site's users (classic browser-side skimmer/loader shape).

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
